description: Clear action items with owners, one decision, nested risk
transcript: Sarah: We need to migrate the database by end of month. Tom: I can lead that, I'll have a plan ready by Wednesday. Sarah: Great. We decided to use PostgreSQL instead of MySQL going forward. Tom: Agreed. One concern — we don't have a staging environment set up yet, that could block the migration.

description: Simple standup — action items only, no decisions, no risks
transcript: Manager: Quick standup. Alice what did you do yesterday? Alice: Finished the auth module. Manager: Good. Bob? Bob: Still working on the dashboard, should be done today. Manager: Ok. No blockers? Bob: Nope. Manager: Good, let's sync again tomorrow.

description: Critical risk should be extracted as high severity
transcript: CEO: We're launching next Friday no matter what. Dev: We still have 3 bugs open. CEO: Ship with known bugs, we'll patch post-launch. Dev: That's risky — users might hit the payment bug, it could break transactions. CEO: Document it. Dev: Ok, I'll write up the known issues doc by Thursday.

description: Hypothetical statements should NOT become action items
transcript: Alice: We should probably refactor the database someday. Bob: That would be nice, but not urgent. Alice: Maybe we could look into it next quarter.

description: Disagreement without resolution should not produce a decision
transcript: Alice: Let's use React. Bob: I strongly disagree. Vue is more performant. Alice: Let's table this and decide next week.
